title: Microsoft Windows Active Directory Domain Services – Core
description: Active Directory Domain Services providing centralized identity, authentication, authorization, and directory services. This component represents the core AD DS capability and is instantiated per domain.

implemented-requirements.description: Active Directory Domain Services provides centralized identification and authentication for domain users, devices, and services using Kerberos.
Active Directory Domain Services manages domain account lifecycle, attributes, and group membership.
Authorization decisions are enforced through group membership and discretionary access control on directory objects.
Credential policies such as password complexity, lifetime, and lockout are enforced through domain and fine-grained password policies.
